description.subtitle: Bayern Munich long adidas trousers - navy blue
description.intro: The adidas Bayern Originals 2.0 pants combine the essence of Munich FC Bayern with the timeless design of adidas Originals. Inspired by the colors of the club’s historic second outfit, it offers a sporty and urban style perfect for any amateur who wants to represent Bayern beyond the stadium.
key_benefits: Collection adidas Originals: Inspired by football legacy with an urban style.
Interlock fabric: Soft, durable and comfortable for daily use.
Elastic waistband with cord: Custom fit and comfort.
Design Bayern Originals: Inspired by the club's historic colors.
Versatile Style: Perfect for combining with casual or sportswear.
